relations: As the camera zooms in, the far screen and left trainer are cropped out, leaving the dolphin and teal banner dominant.
The dolphin keeps its head-down submerged posture while its exposed tail fluke shifts orientation up, left, or right.
The trainer alternates between arms extended outward and bent closer, then drifts toward the right edge as framing tightens.
Surface ripples and colored light reflections shift subtly against the glass viewing wall during the sequence.
caption: The video captures an indoor dolphin show pool, where a backlit screen at the far wall shows dolphin graphics beside white stairs and a diving platform, and a second trainer stands at the left edge. Against the glass viewing wall, a dolphin already holds a vertical, head-down posture, its tail fluke above the surface while the body stays submerged. A trainer in a black wetsuit, a bucket at her hip, stands on the platform beside a tall teal banner, both arms extended outward. As the sequence proceeds, the camera steadily tightens its framing. The screen and the far trainer are cropped away, leaving the dolphin and banner to dominate the view. The dolphin's exposed tail fluke continuously shifts orientation, pointing up, left, or right, while its submerged body stays largely in place. The trainer keeps her arms extended or bent in front of her, alternating between open spreads and closer gestures. Colored light reflections and surface ripples shift subtly, and the trainer moves toward the right edge as the zoom closes.
